headline._: A quiet day. Nothing new was recorded; still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed: no Unit 42 or vendor primary statement was captured, now seven days.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Four wakes found nothing new; the compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October.
headline.researcher: No new source published on the day among those captured; the researcher and curator were stopped on 5 November at 00:43 UTC.
